_comment: Example submissions shown in the web UI: two per stance. 'expect' is what the scorer should do with each (novel = rewarded, common = already said, off_topic = not rewarded). tests/test_examples.py keeps them honest.

support.label: New idea
support.headline: Put a tool library and repair cafe in the park pavilion
support.body: The pavilion could host a lending library for tools and a monthly repair cafe where volunteers fix bikes and small appliances. It would give people a reason to come downtown on quiet weekday evenings.

support.label: Common view
support.headline: Downtown kids finally get somewhere to play
support.body: Families living in downtown apartments have no yard and no playground nearby. A two-acre park would give children a safe green place to play after school.

oppose.label: New idea
oppose.headline: Delivery trucks will end up double-parked on Main Street
oppose.body: Shops receive their deliveries through the garage loading bay. Without it, trucks will double-park on Main Street every morning and block the buses.

oppose.label: Common view
oppose.headline: No parking means no customers
oppose.body: If shoppers cannot find parking near the stores they will drive to the suburban malls instead. Removing the garage will hurt every small business on Main Street.

mixed.label: New idea
mixed.headline: Name the park after the families who ran the old market
mixed.body: The park is a good idea, but I hope the council names it after the families who ran the Saturday market on this block before the garage was built, and puts up a plaque telling that story.

mixed.label: Common view
mixed.headline: The shuttle has to run often to work
mixed.body: A free shuttle sounds good, but if it only comes every half hour nobody will use it. The council needs to commit to frequent service before relying on it.

undecided.label: New idea
undecided.headline: Count how customers actually arrive before deciding
undecided.body: Nobody has measured how many Main Street customers arrive by car versus on foot or by bus. A one-week survey at the shop doors would settle the parking argument with data instead of guesses.

undecided.label: Off-topic
undecided.headline: Our book club is reading a great mystery
undecided.body: This month our book club picked a mystery set on a fishing boat, and nobody guessed the ending. Highly recommend it for a long weekend.
